data.label: Sides
data.note:
A and B relative to the position: which of them it's closer to,
padded with zeros for the axis-by-axis metrics.

data.label: Euclidean
data.note: Straight: the distance to the plane half-way between them.

data.label: Manhattan
data.note:
For each sign pattern σ the far point is ahead of the near one along,
(|far|₁ + σ·near) / 2: the least is the distance.

data.label: Chebyshev
data.note:
For each axis and direction the far point isn't behind on, how far
to half-way along it, the other axes keeping up: the least is the distance.

data.label: Minkowski
data.note:
No closed form: half the gap between the two distances,
exact on the edge itself, approximate away from it.
